emma_optix: Heads up — after we pinned to redwood-embed-v2:2026-03-14 our embeddings length dropped from 1536 to 1024 for our onboarding index. Nightly index jobs fail with assertion 'expected vec_len 1536'. Here's a trimmed sample response we see:

emma_optix: ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-v2",
  "embedding": [0.012, 0.003, ...]  // length 1024
}
```

sara_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact request payload + model param and your project id? also when did you pin (UTC)?

emma_optix: request we call is:

emma_optix: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":["test doc"]}'
```

emma_optix: project: optix-prod (C-3872). Pin happened during onboarding on 2026-03-14 03:10 UTC.

mike_eng_runtime: @sara_support @emma_optix thanks — quick question: did you pin by tag (e.g., redwood-embed-v2:latest) or by digest/immutable ref? pinning by tag can allow routing fallbacks.

emma_optix: we used the console pin UI; it shows the tag redwood-embed-v2 but not a digest.

jordan_platform: note: our routing can substitute a compatible variant when the pinned digest isn't available (capacity / maintenance). In rare cases the substitute uses a quantized/architecture-compatible build that can change embedding width. Investigating the mapping table for optix-prod now.

sara_support: can you repro quickly by calling the embeddings endpoint with the same API key? single vs batch differences?

emma_optix: reproduced locally — single and batched requests both return 1024 length. We dug up a snapshot from last week that still shows 1536.

mike_eng_runtime: looking at routing logs: at 2026-03-14T03:12:06Z a capacity shortage triggered the fallback for project C-3872. Routed to variant redwood-embed-lite-1024-quant. That explains the 1024 vectors. The pin UI did not store an immutable digest so resolution allowed fallback.

ops-bot: [escalation created] escalations/8942 — embed schema variance (optix-prod) — P2

sara_support: immediate workaround: use explicit artifact digest in your request or in pin with the console (e.g., redwood-embed-v2@sha256:abcd...). Emma — can you try specifying the digest in the model field?

emma_optix: tried: using explicit digest returns 1536 as expected. Workaround validated.

sara_support: we've shared the workaround with the customer and opened a ticket to prevent silent variant substitution.

mike_eng_runtime: creating infra task INF-7213: add strict verification in routing that refuses to substitute a variant whose embedding schema (vector width) differs from the pinned model. Emit a clear 409 with reason in API instead of silent substitution. Also adding logging metrics so we can alert on substitution events.

jordan_platform: adding a docs note in pinning runbook about tag vs digest and architecture-incompatible fallbacks. Will also add a console warning when a pin is created without an immutable digest.

sara_support: closing loop for now — customer notified, workaround provided, INF-7213 + docs item logged. I'll follow up when infra has a fix. :thumbsup:

emma_optix: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick response. We'll keep monitoring our ingestion jobs and will re-open if anything else pops up.
